snippet.title: CASE RECORDS: Lost Night | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520330/CASE_RECORDS_Lost_Night/

CASE RECORDS is a series of psychological horror games that are part of the CASE: Animatronics and CASE 2: Animatronics Survival universe.

You go to your quiet, routine job, to an old TV studio. However, this time something went wrong. Having received alarming signals from surveillance cameras, you and your partner discover that an unknown person is on one of the filming sites.

While exploring the studio, you come across a mysterious anomaly - an animatronic doll, which at first glance was just part of the scenery, has disappeared. Now you are involved in someone's sinister game.

The tension increases with each passing minute, because your life is at stake.

Features:
- Mystical atmosphere
- Interactive dialogues and decisions
- Unique mini-games and plot
- Ability to interact with the environment

Get ready, one wrong step or sound can cost you your life.
